description: It was launched by Union Government in 2014, and focused on supporting farmers in producing fodder from non-forest wasteland/grassland and cultivating coarse grains

description: State Government is granting financial assistance in the form of Grant-in-Aid to a person having no employment under the Government, Public Sector undertaking, or under any local bodies may qualify to receive the grand suffering from fell disease.

name: Handicapped Students Stipend Mizoram
description: Under this scheme, provide financial support to differently-abled students for purchasing essential items like books and uniforms. Students enrolled in both government and private schools are eligible to receive a monthly stipend.

name: Mizoram Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme
description: The scheme aims to empower individuals and organizations by providing financial, technical, and institutional support for livelihood, entrepreneurship, and employment generation. It also promotes sustainable socio-economic development and youth engagement in Mizoram.

name: Mizoram Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations and Individuals
description: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to voluntary organizations and individuals to support welfare activities for disadvantaged and marginalized groups such as women, children, disabled persons, elderly, and socially vulnerable individuals.

name: Mizoram Research Fellowship
description: The "Mizoram Research Fellowship" aims to provide financial assistance to research workers and teachers, preferably below the age of 45 years, who have established their reputation for research OR have obtained a doctorate degree OR have published research work to their credit.

name: Mizoram Sports Incentive Cash Award Scheme
description: The scheme aims to provide lump sum cash awards and recognition to outstanding sports persons winning medals in national and international competitions.

name: Post Matric Merit Scholarship
description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to permanent residents of Mizoram States securing 60% marks in Board/University Examination. The scheme is 100% funded by the State Plan Fund.

name: Pre Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
description: The scheme is to provide financial assistance to students belonging to the Scheduled caste community pursuing Post-Matriculation recognized courses in recognized institutions.

description: The objective of the Scheme is to provide financial assistance to Mizo students permanently residing in the States of studying at Sainik School Imphal, to enable them to qualify and joint National Defence Academy and further to the Armed Forces.

name: State Disability Pension
description: The Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Mizoram launched the State Disability Pension scheme. It provides a monthly pension of ₹350 to 200 eligible individuals who are completely blind or bedridden.

name: State Senior Citizens Home
description: The Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Mizoram launched the State Senior Citizens Home for the homeless aged persons. It provides shelter and facilities to homeless elderly individuals aged 60 and above, who lack family support.

name: Stipend to Educated Unemployed
description: Under this scheme, provides a stipend of ₹650 per month to assist 25 educated persons with disabilities who have registered in an Employment Exchange for over three years and have not been placed in gainful employment.

name: The Mizoram Provisional Employees Savings Scheme

name: The Post-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes Students
description: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribes Students" by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India, and Government of Mizoram aims to provide financial assistance to ST students pursuing post-matriculation education. It covers various recognized courses.

description: The Training Centre for Specially-Abled Persons scheme offers vocational courses for specially-abled individuals, funded by the Government of Mizoram. The centers provide courses in tailoring for females and tailoring/shoemaking for males, with a monthly stipend of ₹250 for the…

name: Welfare Services for Children
description: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and development support to vulnerable children such as orphans, street children, child labourers, and children affected by HIV/AIDS. It focuses on shelter, education, health, and rehabilitation services.

name: Welfare Services for Disabled Persons
description: The scheme aims to provide support, rehabilitation, and empowerment to persons with disabilities through financial assistance for healthcare, education, vocational training, and assistive devices.

name: Welfare Services for Other Socially Disabled Persons (Senior Citizens & Destitute)
description: The scheme aims to provide care, protection, and financial assistance to elderly persons and socially disadvantaged individuals lacking family or financial support.

name: Welfare Services for Women
description: The scheme aims to provide welfare support and financial assistance for women in distress, including widows, victims of violence, trafficked women, and economically disadvantaged women.
